name: handy-for-raycast
title: Handy for Raycast
description: The complete Raycast companion for Handy offline speech-to-text.
author: gundu

preferences.name: handyBinaryPath
preferences.title: Handy Binary Path
preferences.description: The Handy executable used for recording controls.

preferences.name: preferPostProcessed
preferences.title: Prefer Post-Processed Text
preferences.description: Copy and paste the AI-refined text when a transcript has one.
preferences.label: Use post-processed text by default

commands.name: toggle-recording
commands.title: Toggle Recording
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Start or finish a Handy recording.

commands.name: record-with-post-processing
commands.title: Record with Post-Processing
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Start or finish a recording and apply Handy's selected AI prompt.

commands.name: cancel-recording
commands.title: Cancel Recording
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Cancel the current recording or transcription.

commands.name: copy-last-transcript
commands.title: Copy Last Transcript
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Copy the latest transcript to the clipboard.

commands.name: paste-last-transcript
commands.title: Paste Last Transcript
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Paste the latest transcript into the frontmost app.

commands.name: search-transcripts
commands.title: Search Transcripts
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Search, inspect, copy, paste, save, rename, and delete transcript history.

commands.name: search-recordings
commands.title: Search Recordings
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Find, play, reveal, and inspect saved audio recordings.

commands.name: add-dictionary-word
commands.title: Add Dictionary Word
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Add one or more terms to Handy's recognition dictionary.

commands.name: manage-dictionary
commands.title: Manage Dictionary
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Search, add, edit, copy, and remove custom dictionary terms.

commands.name: select-model
commands.title: Select Model
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Inspect downloaded transcription models and select one.

commands.name: select-language
commands.title: Select Language
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: Choose automatic detection or a supported transcription language.

commands.name: handy-dashboard
commands.title: Handy Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Handy
commands.description: See Handy status and launch its most useful actions.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Use npm run publish to publish this Raycast extension.' && exit 1
